notes:
Summary:
- Account: mid-sized payments platform; heavy regulatory constraints (PCI scope, EU data residency for certain flows).
- Primary ask: SSO (SAML) + SCIM for user provisioning, audit logs, customer-managed KMS. Must be in first-phase rollout.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2024-09-12: Intro call (Jordan) — high-level product fit, scope = support agents + doc search + fraud rerank. Interested in Private deployment.
- 2024-10-03: Demo w/ SE (Priya) — showed dedicated pool + autoscale; emphasis on latency (p95 < 200ms for chat).
- 2024-10-12: Deep security review (recorded, ff-2024-10-12-orion-demo) — legal/infosec insisted on SAML + SCIM; asked for SOC2/ISO docs (provided).
- 2024-10-25: POC kickoff — engineering provided sample traffic, initial model pins. Ran into identity provisioning gap (we lack SCIM connector for their IdP).
- 2024-11-08: Security sync w/ infra + product (ff-2024-11-08-security-call) — asked for timeline on SSO+SCIM; product roadmap shows earliest availability H1 next year.
- 2024-11-20: Procurement update — budget hold for Q4; exploring competitor that can deliver SAML/SCIM immediately. Last response from champion: "can't go live without SSO in Milestone 1".

Customer quotes / color:
- "We need provisioning + audit trail before any customer data touches your environment." — Head of Infosec
- "If SAML/SCIM isn't in the plan, we'll have to pilot with Vendor X" — Program Manager

POC status & technical notes:
- POC metrics: latency targets met on sample set, cost estimates within expected ARR band.
- Hard blocker: SCIM user provisioning and automatable SSO flows for thousands of internal agents. Manual workarounds are unacceptable for ops.
- Proposed workarounds by us: temporary SAML proxy + manual provisioning scripts; customer rejected due to compliance.

Why deal stalled / risk of closed-lost:
- Security requirement (SSO/SAML + SCIM) is a binary gating item for rollout. Our SSO/SCIM roadmap is H1; customer needs earlier.
- Competitor able to provide connector and SCIM briding in weeks and offered a pilot. Procurement leaning toward competitor to keep timeline.
- No clear internal champion after org restructuring; sponsor moved to another program.

Next steps (short):
- AE to escalate SSO/SCIM priority with Product + Solutions; ask for temporary managed SCIM option from partners.
- Offer an explicit interim controls checklist (additional audit logging, network isolation, contract addendum) to narrow compliance gap.
- Re-open discussion in Jan after roadmap update; request presence of identity engineering in next meeting.

CRM/links & artifacts:
- Security deck (drive:/deals/orion/poc-security-deck_v2.pdf) updated 2024-10-18.
- Internal jira: INF-8421 (POC infra request), SEC-9104 (SSO feature request tracked with Product).

Win probability: low — 20%. Decision driver = SSO timeline and internal champion.

Short, choppy notes from AE logs:
- "10/12 security call: asked for SCIM. Legal says must be automated."
- "11/08 prod says feature H1 — customer unhappy."
- "11/20 procurement freeze + competitor offer — follow up in Jan."
